mainEntity.name: What kind of materials do you procure for luxury outdoor projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: For luxury outdoor projects, we procure a wide array of high-end materials. This commonly includes natural stones such as travertine, granite, and limestone for patios and pathways; premium hardwoods like ipe or teak for decking; custom metalwork for railings or pergolas; state-of-the-art outdoor kitchen appliances; specialized landscape lighting; and advanced irrigation systems. We focus on materials known for their durability, aesthetic appeal, and suitability for the Southern California climate.
acceptedAnswer.description: We procure high-end materials such as natural stones, premium hardwoods, custom metalwork, outdoor kitchen appliances, and specialized lighting for luxury outdoor projects.
